title: Help Our Students Get to China!
body:
Our Rosehill College students are fundraising for an exciting **learning journey to China in 2027**.

This trip will give students the chance to experience a new culture, explore new places, and take their learning beyond the classroom. Your support can help make this opportunity possible.

Every donation, big or small, makes a difference. If you are unable to donate, sharing the fundraiser with your whānau and friends is also a great way to support our students.

[Support our students through Givealittle](https://givealittle.co.nz/cause/learning-beyond-the-classroom-rosehills-2027-china?fbclid=IwY2xjawUA505wZG9mBWV4dG4DYWVtAjEwAGJyaWQRMGdhRndTbWFZMkM0dzB1UGVzcnRjBmFwcF9pZBAyMjIwMzkxNzg4MjAwODkyAAEeqgTzCzvJ3OxRsf_j85oIg3mDa5Smp_ukEHUra3qVtDQt2lagY7Z8dRW2pdU_aem_NUbVmX8i6mjCRugHH6hLbg)

**Thank you for getting behind our students and supporting their journey!**
